visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a graphic title card featuring a gradient background with blue, orange, and yellow hues. Large white text with a blue outline is displayed in the center, identifying the theme of the segment. Small logos and social media tags appear at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) A man wearing a bright yellow short-sleeved shirt is seated outdoors at night. He is surrounded by thick, billowing white smoke that obscures his face as he coughs and waves his hands to clear the air. Colorful neon-like purple and blue lights illuminate the background setting. (3) The man interacts with off-screen companions, looking distressed and rubbing his eyes. He is holding a wooden skewer with grilled food. Despite shifting his position slightly, the cloud of smoke remains directly in front of him, following his movements. (4) The camera cuts to a close-up of the man as he tries to eat the skewer, but he is interrupted by another surge of thick white smoke. He looks up in frustration, blinking rapidly. (5) He changes locations with another male character (Ray), but the smoke immediately drifts toward him in his new seat. He waves his hands frantically. (6) He is then seen holding a white drink carton, attempting to take a sip, yet the smoke persists in following him. (7) Frustrated, he stands up and walks toward an indoor area to escape the smoke. (8) Inside a dimly lit room with warm ambient lighting and wood-paneled walls, he sits on a sofa and exhales a sigh of relief. Just as he opens his drink, a sudden, massive cloud of white smoke fills the room, completely enveloping him again.
